title: Weekly report (AI)
description: AI reviews one week of working with agents: strengths, weaknesses, comparison with last week, a few real prompts as examples and one habit to practise.
privateNote: Uses your own API key. The AI only receives computed numbers and up to 3 example prompts. The result is visible only to you; a leader writing a report about someone else is recorded.
addKey: Add an AI API key to write the weekly report
footer: Visible only to whoever ran it
